kentucky.line: I know a puppy who walked from Kentucky
stanza: I know a puppy who walked from Kentucky
Made it to East Virginia by dawn
He had seventeen ideas in his head

kentucky.line: Especially a fella from eastern Kentucky
stanza: I was out of my mind the first night we met
I was feeling lonely and blue
I'd just moved to the country to get me some rest
The city can put a hurtin' on you
Especially a fella from eastern Kentucky
Without a penny or a worth to his name
Wasting his life on a burnin' desire
And chasing that honky tonk flame

kentucky.line: For the race they put on over in Kentucky
stanza: I put a bet on with a bookie
For the race they put on over in Kentucky
It's lovely at this time of year, so they say
And I've got to get away
Marry me and leave Kentucky
Come to Tennessee
'Cause you're the only ten I see
You're the only ten I see
When I'm walking beside her
People tell me I'm lucky
Yes, I know I'm a lucky guy
I remember the first time
I was lonely without her
Can't stop thinking about her now
But don't you weep (Don't you weep for them)
Don't you weep (Don't you weep)
There is nothing as lucky
Honey, don't you weep (Don't you weep for them)
Don't you weep (Don't you weep)
There is nothing as lucky, as easy, or free
